Demonstrating reach and imposing costs. Advanced Persistent Threat operations: 45 incidents. Long-dwell network intrusions. APT28, APT29, Sandworm. Patient access over months or years, positioned for collection or disruption depending on what the political calendar requires. Influence operations as a discrete category: 41 incidents. Two individuals convicted in a Russian-directed plot against the British PM. A Russian diplomat was identified as the alleged handler. That combination, sabotage plus a pre-built cover narrative, is not improvisation. That's rehearsed. Exiled critics, foreign-based journalists, opposition figures. Research institutions hold dual-use technical knowledge, pre-publication data, and relationships with government and defense adjacent communities.
